Alexis Vega.summary: Alexis Vega is a Mexico left winger from Toluca who gives the national team direct dribbling, set-piece quality, and final-third invention.
Alexis Vega.note: Vega is an attacking change-up for Mexico. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Alexis Vega.noteZh: 他是Mexico的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Alvaro Fidalgo.note: Fidalgo's World Cup has already included a goal against Czechia. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Alvaro Fidalgo.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Armando Gonzalez.note: González is attacking depth for Mexico. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Armando Gonzalez.noteZh: 他是Mexico前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Brian Gutierrez.note: Gutiérrez is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Mexico, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Brian Gutierrez.noteZh: 他给Mexico提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Carlos Acevedo.note: Acevedo gives Mexico a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Carlos Acevedo.noteZh: 他在Mexico首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Cesar Huerta.note: Huerta is an attacking change-up for Mexico. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Cesar Huerta.noteZh: 他是Mexico的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Cesar Montes.note: Montes gives Mexico one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Cesar Montes.noteZh: 他是Mexico无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Edson Alvarez.note: Álvarez gives Mexico defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Edson Alvarez.noteZh: 他是Mexico艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Erik Lira.note: Lira has been one of Mexico's midfield connectors in this tournament. He keeps the next pass alive and helps the team avoid rushed choices.
Erik Lira.noteZh: 他是Mexico让控球不散掉的球员之一。看点是他多早就知道下一脚传给谁。

Gilberto Mora.summary: Gilberto Mora is a Mexico attacking midfielder from Club Tijuana who adds teenage creativity, quick feet, and central chance creation.
Gilberto Mora.note: Mora has been one of Mexico's midfield connectors in this tournament. He keeps the next pass alive and helps the team avoid rushed choices.
Gilberto Mora.noteZh: 他是Mexico让控球不散掉的球员之一。看点是他多早就知道下一脚传给谁。

Guillermo Martinez.note: Martínez is the forward Mexico can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Guillermo Martinez.noteZh: 他给Mexico替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Guillermo Ochoa.note: Ochoa sits behind the starter for Mexico, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Guillermo Ochoa.noteZh: 他给Mexico保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Israel Reyes.note: Reyes is defensive rotation for Mexico. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Israel Reyes.noteZh: 他是Mexico艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Jesus Gallardo.note: Gallardo gives Mexico one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Jesus Gallardo.noteZh: 他是Mexico无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Johan Vasquez.summary: Johan Vásquez is a Mexico centre-back from Genoa who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial power, and Serie A-tested duels.
Johan Vasquez.note: Vásquez has been part of Mexico's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Johan Vasquez.noteZh: 他给Mexico后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Jorge Sanchez.summary: Jorge Sánchez is a Mexico right-back from PAOK who adds wide defending, overlap timing, and national-team experience.
Jorge Sanchez.note: Sánchez has supplied one of Mexico's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Jorge Sanchez.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Mexico创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Julian Quinones.note: Quiñones has given Mexico both the finish and the pass, including goals against South Africa, Czechia, and Ecuador. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Julian Quinones.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给Mexico带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Luis Chavez.note: Chávez gives Mexico midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Luis Chavez.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Mexico来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Luis Romo.note: Romo has already given Mexico a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Luis Romo.noteZh: 他给Mexico展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Mateo Chavez.note: Chávez is on the scoresheet for Mexico, with his goal coming against Czechia. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Mateo Chavez.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Obed Vargas.note: Vargas gives Mexico midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Obed Vargas.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Mexico来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Orbelin Pineda.note: Pineda gives Mexico a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Orbelin Pineda.noteZh: 他是Mexico的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Raul Jimenez.note: Jiménez has been one of Mexico's real scoring stories, with goals against South Africa, Ecuador, and England. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Raul Jimenez.noteZh: 他已经是Mexico这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

Raul Rangel.summary: Raúl Rangel is a Mexico goalkeeper from Guadalajara who gives the national team shot-stopping depth, reflex saves, and modern distribution.
Raul Rangel.note: Rangel has carried the keeper minutes for Mexico. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Raul Rangel.noteZh: 他是Mexico防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Roberto Alvarado.note: Alvarado has already made goals for Mexico against South Africa, Czechia, and Ecuador. Watch the pass before the chance looks obvious.
Roberto Alvarado.noteZh: 他已经多次帮Mexico制造进球。看的是明显机会出现前的那脚传球。

Santiago Gimenez.note: Giménez is one of Mexico's named attacking routes in this tournament. His job is to make the first defender move so the finish or final pass can appear.
Santiago Gimenez.noteZh: 他给Mexico一种把控球变成压力的路线。他要让防守者必须做选择。
